title: Two-point functions in $4-2\,\varepsilon$ dimensions from localization
summary: We study two-point functions of half-BPS operators in maximally supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory continued to $d=4-2\,\varepsilon$ dimensions. Using supersymmetric localization on $S^d$, we derive perturbative matrix-model expressions for the $\varepsilon$-expansion of these correlators and obtain all-loop results at leading order in $\varepsilon$ in the planar limit, with extensions to finite-$N$ corrections and higher-charge operators.
